1.body:
Hello,

I saw the Brand Designer opening at Thinkin Birds and wanted to apply because your focus on understanding why a brand exists before touching Illustrator resonates with my approach.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I design and roll out brand systems, packaging, and digital assets across touchpoints while managing print-ready files with strict attention to bleed and colour accuracy. I also built reusable templates that cut turnaround times for our corporate communications.

My work on the branding kit for AT Creation demonstrates my ability to build early-stage visual identity systems from the ground up, which you can see in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and would love to show you how I handle multi-touchpoint brand rollouts. Could we take fifteen minutes next week to review one of my branding projects?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
